About CET

College of Engineering Trivandrum, established in 1939, is the premier engineering institution in Kerala. With a legacy spanning over eight decades, CET has been the cradle of technological innovation and academic excellence in the region.

Festivals

From the cultural extravaganza of Dhwani to the technical brilliance of Drishti, CET's campus comes alive with vibrant festivals that showcase the talent and creativity of its students.

Events

Guest lectures, hackathons, workshops, and symposiums — CET hosts a dynamic calendar of events throughout the year, bridging academia with industry and innovation.

Sports

CET's sprawling grounds and state-of-the-art facilities nurture champions in athletics, football, cricket, basketball, and more. The annual sports meet remains a highlight of the campus calendar.
